physical.title: blouse
physical.summary: A woman's blouse; long sleeves.  Made of white tabby woven cotton cloth.  Three full weaving widths [44cms wide] have been used; hand stitched.  Gathered neckline with blue blanket stitch embroidery.  'V'-shaped neck opening; overstitching using black woollen yarn over most of centre seam (and both back seams); on either side is a vertical solid line of black raised embroidery (inner) and another vertical line of pink, green and black on an orange 'ground', edged with black.  Upper part of sleeve has a black rectangular embroidered panel with diamond patterning, subdivided by bands of tiny, applied transparent and yellow plastic (?) beads.  Below this is a narrow band of orange, diamond patterned embroidery.  The remainder of the (outer) sleeve has solid black, raised embroidery, broken up with pink and green diagonal markings.  Sleeve gathered onto small cuff; small section of orange cotton smocking beside cuff.  Another two vertical solid lines of black raised embroidery on the back.  Remains of white drawstring.
